author: A Riften storyteller

#Three Who Serve

In the Ratway they say there are always three Nightingales, sworn to the Daedra of luck and darkness, guarding something in a tomb nobody can find. The Guild's luck is their wages.

Most thieves laugh at this. The old ones touch the shadow behind them when they hear it.

#The Curse

The Guild's luck turned, some twenty-five years ago. Jobs went wrong. Fences got caught. Somebody had broken faith, the old ones said, and the darkness was angry.

If that is true, the darkness has a long memory. The Ragged Flagon has been half empty ever since.
